description: Read anything by id. type: thread | topic | wiki | digest | source | related | similar | ledger | ref (default thread). Batch: ids=[...] up to 20 threads. Shrink output with max_chars, or for threads fields=[id,title,topic,status,score,url,summary,tags,body,replies,citations]. topic/digest/wiki take the topic slug as id; wiki also takes page; topic takes sort (hot|top|new|validated) and platform. Example: {"id":"7efe6e44","fields":["title","summary","url"]}
